activejob: suss: this pack's own name, used as RubyPack.name and as boundaryBinding recognition; also the message-bus technology its channels are on
jobClasses: suss: RbJobPattern variant tag, defined in @suss/adapter-ruby
mailers: suss: RbJobPattern variant tag, defined in @suss/adapter-ruby
ApplicationJob: Rails: the base class every generated job extends
ApplicationMailer: Rails: the base class every generated mailer extends
perform: ActiveJob: ActiveJob::Base#perform, the method a worker runs with the job's arguments
set: ActiveJob: ActiveJob::Core::ClassMethods#set, which returns the job class with wait, queue or priority options for the enqueue after it
queue_as: ActiveJob: ActiveJob::QueueName::ClassMethods#queue_as, which declares the queue a job class runs on
deliver_later: ActionMailer: ActionMailer::MessageDelivery#deliver_later, which enqueues a built message to be sent by a worker
with: ActionMailer: ActionMailer::Parameterized::ClassMethods#with, which returns the mailer with params set for the message built on it
